$comment: FIT-03 net-event allowlist — every RegisterNetEvent in custom-police/server and custom-phone/server that does NOT contain a unified auth token (PolicePolicy.Can / a verified auth helper) must be registered here. Checked by tests/architecture/test_net_event_auth.py. Adding a new net event without auth fails CI; the fix is to add PolicePolicy.Can(...) instead of another entry.

categories.already_checked: handler does a manual permission check (job.type / PolicePolicy.IsPolice / onduty / item) that is NOT the capability table; the evidence field names it
categories.civilian: must stay reachable by non-police players; validated and/or rate limited inside the handler instead of capability-gated
categories.session: handler is bound to the caller's own session/ownership (own phone number, own job board row, own tracker, own backup request) — no cross-player write
categories.diagnostic: telemetry-only channel (server log); table-typed, whitelisted fields, rate limited per source
categories.unchecked_debt: known missing check, registered so it cannot silently grow; must be fixed or re-justified before expires

entries.name: evidence:server:UpdateStatus
entries.reason: 玩家自己身上的状态列表（红手、火药味、醉酒…）由本人客户端上报，不能要求警察身份；服务端只接受 table 并重建白名单副本（键数 ≤13、text ≤64、time ≤3600）。

entries.name: evidence:server:CreateBloodDrop

entries.evidence: evidence.lua:239 CreateBloodDrop — dna := player.PlayerData.citizenid, coordsNearSource(src, coords), trackDrop 上限 500/TTL 1800s

entries.name: evidence:server:CreateCasing

entries.name: phone:server:appQueryRequest
entries.reason: 职业 App 查询入口：任何玩家都可以请求，但 PhoneApps.Query 会按 app_id 注册的 audience（job/onduty）拒绝未授权玩家；handler 只接受 3–64 字符 request_id 与 table，每玩家 token bucket（app:<cid>:query）限流，响应只回传 request_id 和结果，不回显参数。
entries.evidence: main.lua:1364 appQueryRequest — validAppRequestId + type(data)=='table' + PhoneRateLimit.Allow(appRateKey) + PhoneApps.Query(src, ...) audience check, unicast to src

entries.reason: 职业 App 动作入口：PhoneApps.Action 同样在注册表内按 audience 复验权限/在勤，handler 只接受 3–64 字符 request_id 与 table，每玩家 token bucket（app:<cid>:action）限流，结果按调用者 source 单播回传。
entries.evidence: main.lua:1385 appActionRequest — validAppRequestId + type(data)=='table' + PhoneRateLimit.Allow(appRateKey) + PhoneApps.Action(src, ...) audience check, unicast to src

entries.name: phone:server:diag
entries.reason: 四段往返诊断通道：只写服务端日志，不写库、不回包、不构成 RPC 面。payload 经 Sanitize 白名单投影（tid 3..64+字符集校验、kind/app/code 字符集与长度收敛、phases 最多 8 且序号 1..8、ui phase 必须在 13 项白名单内），trace 批次走 PhoneRateLimit 令牌桶 20/min burst 5，ui 事件按 (phase, src) 5s 冷却，另有全局每秒钟 50 行打印预算与 dropped 计数，客户端无法刷屏或注入。
entries.evidence: server/core/diag.lua:387 PhoneDiag.Accept — Sanitize + allowTrace(PhoneRateLimit 20/5) + allowUi(5s) + printBudgetOk(50/s)

entries.name: phone:server:nuiReady
entries.reason: NUI 自证握手：页面加载时把自己跑的是哪个 build、location.host 与 GetParentResourceName() 报给服务端，用于判定'改完不生效'是旧 bundle 缓存还是路由不通。只读取 build/host/parent/href 四个字符串字段，逐字符集收敛并截断；每 source 5s 一条，不写库、不回包、不涉及玩家数据。
entries.evidence: main.lua phone:server:nuiReady — NUI_READY_COOLDOWN_MS=5000 + field() gsub 收敛并截断

entries.name: phone:server:nuiProbe
entries.reason: 四段探针结果回报：NUI 用一次真实 appQuery 走完 NUI→client→server→回包→NUI 后把终态码与耗时报给服务端，作为每次资源重启的端到端自检。只读取 code/build 两个字符串（字符集收敛 + 截断）与 dur 数字；每 source 3s 一条，不写库、不回包、不涉及玩家数据。
entries.evidence: main.lua phone:server:nuiProbe — PROBE_COOLDOWN_MS=3000 + code/build gsub 收敛 + dur 取整

entries.name: core-framework:server:clientReady
entries.reason: 客户端资源加载完成信标。客户端 print 只进 F8、服务端看不到，这个通道让"新客户端代码到底有没有加载"能从服务端日志回答。不含业务数据，只写一行日志。
entries.evidence: client_reports.lua:clientReady — allow() 走 RateLimitWindow 3/60s + clean(resourceName,64) + clean(version,32) 白名单字符集

entries.name: core-framework:server:clientReport
entries.reason: 客户端错误/降级上报（CFShared.Report）。只接 kind 白名单与一条 message，去控制字符后截断到 400 字，防止客户端伪造多行服务端日志；每玩家 10 条/分钟。
entries.evidence: client_reports.lua:clientReport — KINDS 白名单 + clean(message,400) 去 %c + allow() RateLimitWindow 10/60s

entries.name: police:server:backupAck
entries.reason: 阶段上报只对自己名下的活动单位生效：requestId 必须命中调用者 citizenid 的预算条目、entry.cid/entry.source 必须与调用者一致、阶段必须在 backup_contract 的白名单里且只能向前。其余一律丢弃并采样写 backup.ack_rejected（同单 10 秒一条），客户端无法推进/回退别人的单位。
entries.evidence: p2_system.lua backupAck — ownsBackupUnit(cid, requestId) + BackupContract.NormalizePhase + CanAdvance(entry.phase, phase) 三重校验，失败走 recordAckRejected
